Недвижимость в Sea Breeze можно использовать как для проживания, так и в качестве источника прибыли. У резидента есть возможность сдавать её в аренду через управляющую компанию и получать стабильный доход.

title: Satılır 2 otaqlı yeni tikili 98 m²
description:
WOODVILLE | SEA BREEZE

A suburban living concept in the heart of nature.

Privacy, comfort, and natural aesthetics—all in one place.

Located within the Sea Breeze development, Woodville is a low-rise residential complex comprising townhouses and apartments, offering a suburban lifestyle immersed in lush greenery.

The key advantage of the Woodville project lies in its low-rise, nature-oriented living concept, which sets it apart from conventional high-rise residential developments.

Featuring a natural aesthetic, the townhouses blend modern architecture with natural materials, creating a distinct seaside living atmosphere. Comprising just 46 units, the project consists of 2- to 3-story buildings, offering a quieter environment that prioritizes privacy. 

KEY FEATURES OF THE PROJECT:

- 46 apartments – a limited number of residential units
- 2–3 story buildings – a low-rise residential concept
- Brick walls
- Individual heating system (combi boiler)
- Gas, hot water, and internet access
- Backup generator and satellite connectivity
- 24/7 security service and surveillance cameras

SEA BREEZE INFRASTRUCTURE:

Residents of Woodville have access to Sea Breeze’s extensive leisure, sports, and social infrastructure:

- Hotels, a beach club, and a yacht pier
- Bars, restaurants, and food court areas
- Dedicated event venues
- Retail and entertainment center
- SPA & Wellness and fitness center
- Sports grounds and children’s play areas
- A school and a 24/7 market
- ​​Medical and emergency services
- 24-hour reception service

A DISTINCTIVE RESIDENTIAL CHOICE:

Woodville is designed for those who wish to step away from the dense urban environment and embrace a quieter, more private lifestyle amidst lush greenery. Modern architecture, low-rise buildings, and the extensive infrastructure of Sea Breeze make this project an excellent choice—whether for personal residence or as an investment in seaside real estate.

WOODVILLE — live closer to nature without sacrificing urban comforts.
